integrity: The originating Gibbs invariant measure, zero-range formulation and thermodynamic current are credited to prior literature; the new claim is the complete sector classification, finite conditional current, and frozen-density entropy. Numerical checks do not replace proofs.
scientific_limitations: Finite periodic rings with positive bidirectional rates; marked mobile sectors and unmarked frozen census; fixed integer hop length, interior-density entropy; no mixing time or hydrodynamic claims. Literature priority remains subject to expert review.
title: Exact dynamical sectors and a frozen-density threshold in long-jump exclusion
